question: Find the sum of all those prime numbers which are less than 28.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

List the **prime numbers** less than 28: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23.

Group the numbers to simplify the addition: (2 + 3 + 5) + (7 + 13) + (11 + 19) + (17 + 23).

Step 1: 10 + 20 + 30 + 40 = 100.

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** We need to find the sum of all **prime numbers** smaller than 28.

**Definition:** A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a03bd7f5a7a3ed78cc7cd7240ab4e7715667e98f6c74bc40a8431f99c02802f1.png] 

⇒ Identify prime numbers between 1 and 28: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23.

⇒ Sum = 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 + 13 + 17 + 19 + 23

⇒ Sum = (2 + 3 + 5) + (7 + 11 + 13) + (17 + 19 + 23)

⇒ Sum = 10 + 31 + 59

⇒ Sum = 100.

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Prime Numbers

Numbers that have exactly two factors, 1 and the number itself. Example: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11...

Even Prime Number

2 is the only **even prime number** and it is the smallest prime number.

Composite Numbers

Numbers having more than two factors are called composite numbers. 1 is neither prime nor composite.

Twin Primes

Pairs of prime numbers that have a difference of 2 are called twin primes (e.g., 3 and 5, 5 and 7).</p
